关键词: The Industrial Development Authority of the County of Pima
Industrial Development Revenue Bonds, 2013 Series A
主要内容: On March 14, 2013, The Industrial Development Authority of the County of Pima issued and sold $90,745,000 aggregate principal amount of tax-exempt industrial development revenue bonds for the benefit of Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP). The bonds bear interest at a fixed rate of 4.00%, payable semi-annually on March 1 and September 1 of each year, starting September 1, 2013, and mature on September 1, 2029. The bonds were issued under an Indenture of Trust dated March 1, 2013, between the Authority and U.S. Bank Trust National Association. The proceeds from the sale of the bonds, along with funds provided by TEP, will be used to redeem an outstanding series of tax-exempt bonds with a principal amount of $90,745,000. The bonds to be redeemed bear interest at 6.375% per annum and have a maturity date of September 1, 2029. TEP is obligated to make payments to cover the principal, premium, and interest on the bonds under the Loan Agreement dated March 1, 2013. TEP’s obligations under the Loan Agreement are unsecured.
